messages.content: [2026 FIFA World Cup Group F] Group F of the 2026 FIFA World Cup took place from June 14 to 25, 2026. The group consisted of the Netherlands, Japan, Sweden, and Tunisia. The Netherlands topped the group, winning two games and drawing the other. Japan finished as runners-up, winning one game and drawing the other two. Both teams advanced to the round of 32. Sweden finished in third place, and their performance allowed them to advance as one of the eight best third-place teams. However, the three teams performed poorly in the round of 32 and were eliminated from the World Cup.
